plants.name: Prunus × yedoensis
plants.description: Clouds of blush-white blossoms cover bare branches before the leaves appear. Each spring, parks and riverbanks turn into drifts of pale petals that fall like snow in the breeze.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late March to mid-April, with peak bloom usually in the final days of March in Tokyo and early April in Washington, D.C.
plants.funFact: Nearly all Yoshino cherry trees are clones, grafted from a single original tree. That is why a whole city's trees tend to burst into bloom within days of each other.

plants.name: Narcissus pseudonarcissus
plants.description: Nodding golden trumpets surrounded by paler yellow petals light up woodland floors and meadows. Whole hillsides glow with them when they bloom together.
plants.bloomingSeason: March to April, with the display usually at its best around late March
plants.location: Woodlands and meadows of western Europe, including England, Wales and France
plants.funFact: All parts of the daffodil contain toxic alkaloids. One of them, galantamine, has been developed into a medicine used to treat symptoms of Alzheimer's disease.
